page.overview:
Who is Blind Master?

He trained Snake Eyes after death of Hard Master

Blind Master sent Snake Eyes and Jinx to bring Storm Shadow to reveal what he knew about Cobra's plan to rule the world and learns that Storm was framed for Hard Master's death.
